question: Which office owns the organization business-continuity, archive and succession (inheritance) records, what do those records contain, who may read them and how long must they be kept?
decision: Not a launch capability. Retire the continuity archive, docs and inheritance aliases (deny, visible as retired). pending_profiles stays unreachable through generic CRUD. Revisit as a new feature after launch.
